The "2015" vs "15" is just year format difference (4-digit vs 2-digit). But ".06" vs ".01" — is that a real difference or could "15.01" be the 15th year? Alternatively, "NL1-2015.06" could be NMi's certificate numbering where 2015 is the year and .06 is a sequence. "NL1-15.01" would be year 15 (2015), sequence 01. The mismatch of 06 vs 01 is concerning.

However, the rules say: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form." The cert_id matches (3877), the source PDF filename is "r129-2000-nl1-2015-06.pdf" which matches the register's "R129/2000-NL1-2015.06". So the register and the file agree. Given extraction_method glm-5.3-flash, OCR misreads are plausible (0↔6 confusion... hmm, 6 vs 1 is not a typical OCR confusion, but 0 vs 1 less likely).

The safest interpretation per the rules: it's a number/year format difference denoting the same certificate (year 2015 vs 15 match), so verdict "same-entity" with best_value = register's canonical form "R129/2000-NL1-2015.06".

But could it be "different-entity"? The rule for different-entity is about company or person names. For numbers, the rule is only "same-entity ... with the register's canonical form" or document-noise. Given the embedded metadata (cert_id 3877, num R129/2000-NL1-2015.06) matches the register exactly, and the PDF filename matches, the document-text "R129/2000-NL1-15.01" is likely an OCR/extraction artifact of the same certificate. Verdict: same-entity, best_value register.

Alternatively "document-noise" with best_value from register would also make sense since the document text value may be an OCR error. Which is better? The rules: "Number/year format differences that clearly denote the same certificate = same-entity with the register's canonical form." The year "2015" vs "15" is clearly a format difference. The trailing "06" vs "01" — hmm. "Clearly denote the same certificate"? The cert_id 3877 embedded in the document context ties it to register row 3877, and the PDF filename r129-2000-nl1-2015-06 confirms. So yes, same certificate.

I'll go with same-entity, best_value "R129/2000-NL1-2015.06", why: the document's "15.01" is a year-format/OCR variant of the same certificate (year 15 = 2015, and embedded metadata cert_id 3877 + PDF filename match the register).
